robot.name: UBTECH Walker S1
robot.status_notes: Catalog record lists Walker S1 as superseded and followed by Walker S2. Sources describe Walker S1 training at Zeekr's 5G Smart Factory, media-reported integration at BYD and Audi, and UBTECH marketing for vehicle assembly lines. No public UBTECH price was found; the product page uses a contact form.
intended_use_cases: collaboration with AMRs/AGVs in smart factories

height.notes: Third-party reseller/directory listings; UBTECH product page specifications were not available as text in the reviewed source. A DriveSpark article gives 5.6 feet, approximately 171 cm.

weight.notes: Third-party listings; DriveSpark gives 167.6 pounds, approximately 76 kg.

payload.notes: Reported by Robot Overflow, added 2026-10-30 by automated spec fill; Converted from pounds to kilograms; reported as Walker S1 payload..

runtime.notes: Third-party listing value; no UBTECH runtime disclosure found in reviewed text.

battery.notes: Battery capacity, chemistry and charging specification were not published in reviewed sources.

walking_speed.original_value: 3 km/h walking speed; 5 km/h max speed listed
walking_speed.notes: Directory value only; UBTECH page did not provide a text speed spec. Humanoid.guide separately lists max speed 5 km/h.

degrees_of_freedom.notes: Overall body DoF per third-party listings. Hand DoF not published.

hands.description: No hand degrees of freedom, finger count or tactile-sensing specification found. Sources describe dexterous manipulation claims and precision-assembly tasks, but not hand hardware.

items: 360° multimodal perception including integrated head sensor design and stereo/vision components (third-party marketplace description; exact stack varies)

compute.description: No CPU/GPU, onboard compute or operating system specification published in reviewed sources; Humanoid.guide lists CPU/GPU as N/A.

actuators.description: No actuator model, torque, gear or cooling specification published. UBTECH lists joint cooling during long-term high-load operation as one of three key industrial application challenges.

availability.notes: UBTECH product page offers a contact-us/partner form, not a public price or checkout. Third-party listings conflict: Latin Satelital lists US$37,500 and 'In stock'; Humanoid.guide shows 75,000 USD and availability Prototype. Neither is an official UBTECH price.

manipulation_dexterity.summary: UBTECH claims dexterous manipulation and learning-based whole-body control; heise reports Zeekr tasks including sorting, handling and precision assembly; Tech in Asia reports lifting heavy boxes and processing delicate materials. No hand DoF, success rates or independent trials published.
caveats: Tasks are described by UBTECH or media, not measured.
No hand hardware or payload specification.
Zeekr work is described as training, not production output.

autonomy_task_execution.summary: UBTECH claims LLM task planning and BrainNet multi-robot coordination; heise reports several dozen Walker S1s trained together at Zeekr; Tech in Asia says robots work autonomously on coordinated lifting and transport tasks. No intervention logs or teleoperation disclosure were found.
caveats: Autonomy is company/media-asserted.
No published intervention or failure counts.
Training context, not sustained production.

mobility_whole_body_control.summary: UBTECH claims learning-based whole-body motion control for stable walking and dexterous manipulation; a third-party directory lists walking, running and stair climbing and 3 km/h walking speed, but these directory claims are unverified. Factory reports show walking and coordinated lifting.
caveats: No official speed, gait or fall-rate data.
Walking, running and stair claims come from an unverified directory.
No independent mobility test.

perception_scene_understanding.summary: UBTECH claims semantic VSLAM navigation coupling semantic perception with visual SLAM for spatial understanding and visual positioning under varying lighting; a reseller listing mentions 360° multimodal perception. No sensor stack or benchmark was published.
caveats: Company and marketplace claims only.
No camera, LiDAR or compute specifications.
No third-party perception benchmark.

human_interaction.summary: No official human-interaction capability for Walker S1 was found. A third-party directory makes generic claims about voice commands and face recognition, but UBTECH's reviewed industrial materials do not detail human interaction.
caveats: Only a generic directory claim; not credited.
Industrial use case does not establish safe human interaction.

endurance_reliability.summary: Third-party listings give up to about 2 hours runtime. UBTECH lists joint cooling under long-term high-load operation as a challenge. No uptime, MTBF or long-duration test data found.
caveats: Runtime is a third-party listing, not an official text spec.
No reliability or endurance test published.
Joint cooling is listed as an application challenge by UBTECH.

human_environment_fit.summary: Walker S1 is a human-scale biped, about 172 cm and 76 kg, intended for human-designed factory spaces and vehicle assembly lines. No safety certification, force-limiting or human-proximity data found.
caveats: Height and weight come from third-party listings.
No functional safety or human-robot collaboration certification found.
76 kg mass and industrial tasks require safety assessment.

deployment_commercial_proof.summary: Several dozen Walker S1 units were reported training at Zeekr's 5G Smart Factory, with media reports of about 20 units; BYD and Audi integrations are media-reported; one article claims over 500 orders. No customer press release, output metrics or operating hours were found.
caveats: Zeekr work is training/collaborative training, not confirmed production deployment.
BYD and Audi reports are secondary media, not customer releases.
The 500-order claim is unverified.
No unit output, cycle time or intervention rate.

accessibility_value.summary: No official UBTECH price or public purchase path was found; the product page uses a contact form. Third-party listings show conflicting prices, US$37,500 and 75,000 USD, and one lists Prototype availability.
caveats: Not publicly purchasable at a verified price.
Reseller and directory prices conflict and are not official.
No lease, waitlist or consumer offering found.

researcher_notes.short_verdict_for_arena: This pack was compiled automatically from public sources on 2026-10-30 and needs human review. Walker S1 has credible media evidence of multi-unit collaborative training at Zeekr and media-reported BYD and Audi integration, but the public record lacks official UBTECH text specifications, customer output metrics, autonomy disclosure and an official price.
strongest_positive_evidence: heise online reports several dozen Walker S1s trained and used in vehicle/final assembly and quality inspection at Zeekr.
Tech in Asia independently reports Walker S1 deployment at Zeekr's Ningbo EV factory, with about 20 units indicated by images.
UBTECH product page claims LLM task planning, semantic VSLAM, learning-based whole-body control and vehicle-line collaboration.
Media reports place Walker S1 at BYD and Audi, though without customer releases or metrics.
weakest_or_missing_evidence: No official UBTECH text specifications for height, weight, DoF, runtime, speed, payload, battery, hands, sensors or compute.
No customer press release, operating hours, output metrics or intervention rate from Zeekr, BYD or Audi.
No disclosed teleoperation/autonomy status or independent audit.
No official price or purchase path; reseller prices conflict.
conflicting_claims: Height: 172 cm in Humanoid.guide and Latin Satelital vs 5.6 feet in DriveSpark (approximately 171 cm).
Price: Latin Satelital lists US$37,500; Humanoid.guide shows 75,000 USD; UBTECH has no public price.
Description: Humanoid.guide describes home/office tasks, while UBTECH and other sources frame Walker S1 as industrial.
Units at Zeekr: heise says several dozen; Tech in Asia says exact number not disclosed and images indicate about 20.
Runtime: third-party listings give up to about 2 hours; no official UBTECH runtime text found.
do_not_overclaim: Do not credit the $20,000 home-companion robot claim to Walker S1.
Do not treat reseller prices as official UBTECH prices.
Do not treat Zeekr training as full production deployment.
Do not treat the over-500-orders claim as verified.
Do not claim autonomous operation without teleoperation disclosure or intervention logs.

currentness.currentness_notes: Catalog record lists Walker S1 as superseded and followed by Walker S2. Walker S1 remains referenced in media and product pages as an industrial humanoid.

arena_prompt_summary.one_paragraph_summary: UBTECH Walker S1 is a Chinese biped industrial humanoid listed by third-party sources at about 172 cm, 76 kg, 41 DoF and up to 2 hours runtime. UBTECH markets LLM task planning, semantic VSLAM and learning-based whole-body control and says it has entered vehicle assembly lines; reputable media report several dozen units training collaboratively at Zeekr's 5G Smart Factory, while BYD and Audi integration and a 500-order claim come from secondary media. No UBTECH price, payload, battery, hand DoF or independent performance metrics were found, and teleoperation/autonomy is not disclosed.
strongest_evidence: heise online report of several dozen Walker S1s trained and used in vehicle/final assembly and quality inspection at Zeekr (ubtech-walker-s1_evidence_005).
Tech in Asia report of Walker S1 deployment at Zeekr's Ningbo EV factory with about 20 units indicated by images (ubtech-walker-s1_evidence_008).
UBTECH product-page claims for LLM planning, semantic VSLAM, whole-body control and vehicle-line collaboration (ubtech-walker-s1_evidence_001, 002, 003, 004).
Media reports of BYD and Audi integration, though not customer-confirmed with metrics (ubtech-walker-s1_evidence_010, 012).
weakest_evidence: No official UBTECH text specifications, payload, battery, hand DoF or compute.
No customer press release or output/hours/intervention metrics from Zeekr, BYD or Audi.
No disclosed autonomy/teleoperation status or independent verification.
No official price; reseller prices conflict.
